notes: 0.20.0-beta.1: Stage 5 beta 1, procedure forms with badges only. Settings → Patient forms → Procedure forms: one table tying code groups to consents, before-visit and aftercare pages (16 starter rows, documents to pick). Appointments' procedures are read and matched; the schedule badge turns grey, amber or red for consents needed; a This visit block on the patient page; Follow-ups → Consents needed today (switch in the table's page); Sign now hands the device to the patient for this visit's consents and before-visit page; coverage rules (until done, for N months, until a new version). A procedure consent may publish with its Spanish still a draft. Import a file now takes a bundle of documents; Summerbrook's Flex consents and post-op pages come in that way. No sending yet (beta 2). Migration 18 part 1.
